title: Where rain comes from
topic: the water cycle, for a curious beginner
bigQuestion: How does water get from the sea into a raincloud?

scenes.narration: The rain on your window was in the ocean last week.
scenes.visualAction: Wide shot. Wally stands at a rain-streaked window and points a paw at one running drop.

scenes.narration: The sun heats the surface of the sea all day long.
scenes.visualAction: Cut to a flat sea under a large sun. Warm arrows rise off the water.

scenes.narration: That heat turns the top layer of water into invisible vapour.
scenes.visualAction: Close shot on the sea surface. Tiny water shapes lift off and fade out of view.

scenes.narration: Warm vapour is light, so it climbs.
scenes.visualAction: The camera tilts up with a column of pale vapour as it rises past Wally.

scenes.narration: Higher up, the air is much colder.
scenes.visualAction: Wally holds a big thermometer beside the rising column. The reading drops.

scenes.narration: Cold makes the vapour gather back into tiny drops.
scenes.visualAction: Extreme close shot. Specks of vapour meet and join into small round drops.

scenes.narration: Millions of those drops together are what you call a cloud.
scenes.visualAction: The camera pulls back fast from one drop to a whole white cloud.

scenes.narration: A cloud is not a bag of water. It is a crowd of drops.
scenes.visualAction: Wally cuts a cloud open like a loaf. Inside are separate floating drops, not a pool.

scenes.narration: The drops bump, join, and slowly grow heavier.
scenes.visualAction: Two drops collide and merge. The new drop sinks a little in the frame.

scenes.narration: When a drop is too heavy for the air to hold, it falls.
scenes.visualAction: One fat drop breaks away and drops out of the bottom of the cloud.

scenes.narration: That fall is rain, and it lands back in the sea.
scenes.visualAction: Wide shot of rain falling into the same ocean from the second scene.

scenes.narration: Sun lifts it, cold gathers it, weight drops it. Then it starts again.
scenes.visualAction: Wally traces a full circle diagram of sea, vapour, cloud and rain with his paw.
